name: GOV extended: CancelTransaction (Compound Timelock)
description: Compound Timelock: CancelTransaction(bytes32,address,uint256,string,bytes,uint256) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity info. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
